verdict.rationale: Probes of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known) all returned 404. The only OpenAPI file found, at /api-reference/openapi.json, is titled "OpenAPI Plant Store", which appears to be a docs-template placeholder rather than a description of Bento's own API. Nothing shows a downloadable machine-readable spec of Bento's API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
